{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out invalid ages (0 to 120 inclusive)
df_valid = df[(df['customer_age'] >= 0) & (df['customer_age'] <= 120)]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age_valid = df_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Check how many rows were removed
n_invalid = len(df) - len(df_valid)

n_invalid, mean_age_valid"}
